extracted.name: Spinach Salad
extracted.description: This easy spinach salad recipe is a fresh, delicious side dish or lunch! To get ahead, prepare the candied pecans and apple cider vinaigrette in advance. Store the pecans at room temperature for up to a week and the dressing in the fridge for up to 5 days.
ingredient_lines: ⅓ cup thinly sliced red onion
2 ounces crumbled goat cheese or ¼ cup shaved pecorino cheese
Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
instruction_lines: In a large bowl, place the spinach, apple, and onion. Add some of the dressing and toss to combine.
Add the pecans, goat cheese, and cranberries and gently toss. Add more dressing, as desired. Season to taste and serve.
